# A Fixture Paper on Citations

## Introduction

Paradigms shift when anomalies accumulate (Kuhn, 1962). Lending follows growth (Lindqvist & Berg, 2012). The same shift recurs (Kuhn, 1962).

Several studies agree (Lindqvist & Berg, 2012; Okafor, 2019). Trust can be measured (Okafor, 2019, p. 40). Networks persist (Okafor, 2019, p. 41).

## Discussion

Lindqvist & Berg (2012) argue that lending policy follows growth.
